lines.text: Will AI replace video editors? Let's be honest about it.
AI is great at the repetitive work. Cutting silences. Syncing captions. Resizing one video for every platform.
Jobs that ate a whole afternoon can now take minutes.
But on its own, it doesn't have taste. Which moment matters. When to hold a shot. When to cut.
So the job isn't disappearing. It's changing. Less clicking. More deciding.
An editor who can direct AI can do the work of a small team.
The editor of the future is a director. And the future starts this week.
